name: Le Rak Son Rai
original_name: เล่ห์รักซ่อนร้าย
overview: A young woman loses her only younger sister because of a greedy and insatiable man. Her desire for revenge initiates a fake relationship between her and that man's younger sister. She resorts to using tricks to win the heart of her enemy's younger sister, not realizing that she will be the one to feel more. Adapted from the novel "Scheme of Love" (เล่ห์รักซ่อนร้าย) by Flower of Memory (ดอกไม้แห่งความทรงจำ).
